customer_query: @user I can't log into my account, it keeps saying password incorrect even though I just reset it! Help!
agent_resolution: Hey! Sorry to hear that. Could you try a private/incognito browser window to reset your password? If that doesn't work, DM us your account email and we'll check it on our end.

customer_query: @user Somebody changed my email address on my Spotify account and I'm locked out! Was I hacked??
agent_resolution: Hey there! We take account security very seriously. Please send us a direct message with any receipts or your username so our security team can secure and restore your account.

customer_query: @user It's asking for a 2-factor code on login but I never get the SMS code on my phone.
agent_resolution: Hi! Make sure your carrier isn't filtering shortcode texts. You can also try requesting the code via backup email or DM us with your username to verify your account.

customer_query: @user Trying to invite my partner to my Family Plan but it says we don't live at the same address when we do!
agent_resolution: Hey! Both accounts must have identical address formatting, including apartment/unit numbers. Try copy-pasting the exact address from the plan manager's account page.

customer_query: @user My student discount verification failed through SheerID even though I am an active student.
agent_resolution: Hi! SheerID requires an official current enrollment document dated within the last 3 months. Check out [LINK] or contact SheerID support to re-upload your document.

customer_query: @user Why was I charged twice this month for Spotify Premium? $10.99 showed up twice on my card!
agent_resolution: Hey! That usually happens if there's a duplicate account created under a different email or Facebook login. DM us the last 4 digits of your card and billing zip code so we can trace the second charge.

customer_query: @user I canceled my Premium subscription two weeks ago and you guys still charged me today! Refund please!
agent_resolution: Hey there, sorry for the confusion! Let's get that looked at right away. Send us a quick DM with your account email and we will review the cancellation timestamp and process your refund.

customer_query: @user I bought a 12-month Spotify gift card at Target and when I enter the code it says already redeemed!
agent_resolution: Hi! Please make sure your account country matches the country where the gift card was purchased. If it does, DM us a photo of the card receipt and PIN code.

customer_query: @user How do I change my payment method from PayPal to Apple Pay on Spotify?
agent_resolution: Hey! You can update your payment method directly at spotify.com/account under 'Manage Plan'. If your subscription is billed through Apple, you'll need to update it in your Apple ID settings.

customer_query: @user Charged for Duo plan even though my partner canceled their invite.
agent_resolution: Hey there! The Duo plan charges the manager regardless of whether the second member accepts. You can downgrade to Individual at spotify.com/account anytime.

customer_query: @user All my downloaded offline songs keep pausing after 10 seconds on my iPhone with iOS 17!
agent_resolution: Hey! Try doing a clean reinstall: uninstall Spotify, restart your phone, and reinstall from the App Store. Also make sure 'Background App Refresh' is turned on in iOS Settings.

customer_query: @user The desktop app crashes instantly every time I try to open it on Windows 11. Was working fine yesterday.
agent_resolution: Hi! Let's fix that. Try clearing your Spotify cache located at %localappdata%\Spotify\Storage and delete the prefs file. Then launch the app again as administrator.

customer_query: @user Songs stutter and skip constantly when connected to my car Bluetooth, but other audio apps work fine.
agent_resolution: Hey! Try toggling off 'Hardware Acceleration' in Spotify Settings and disable 'Audio Normalization'. Unpairing and re-pairing the Bluetooth device also frequently clears this up.

customer_query: @user Spotify Connect won't find my Sonos or Alexa speakers anymore on my home WiFi.
agent_resolution: Hi! Make sure both your phone and smart speakers are on the same Wi-Fi frequency band (2.4GHz vs 5GHz) and restart your router. Let us know if that helps!

customer_query: @user Local files won't sync from my PC to my Android phone no matter what I do.
agent_resolution: Hey! Ensure both devices are connected to the exact same Wi-Fi network and that Spotify is allowed through your Windows Firewall. Then toggle 'Show Local Files' off and on.

customer_query: @user Why is the new Drake album completely greyed out on my playlist in the UK?
agent_resolution: Hey! Greyed-out tracks usually mean the rights holder or record label hasn't made streaming available in your region yet, or licensing agreements are being renewed.

customer_query: @user The explicit version of this song plays the clean radio edit even though my Explicit Content filter is set to ALLOW.
agent_resolution: Hi! Try searching for the album directly and look for the '1 More Release' or explicit badge at the bottom right of the tracklist. Clear app cache if it persists.

customer_query: @user All my custom playlists from the last 5 years just completely vanished from my library today!!
agent_resolution: Don't panic! You can recover deleted playlists at spotify.com/account/recover-playlists. Log in and click 'Restore' next to any playlist you want back.

customer_query: @user Podcasts aren't showing the latest episodes even though the RSS feed updated 4 hours ago.
agent_resolution: Hey! Podcast episode propagation can take up to 24 hours across global CDNs. If it's still missing after 24 hours, DM us the podcast link and episode title.

customer_query: @user Is Spotify Car Thing officially discontinued? Mine won't connect anymore.
agent_resolution: Hi there! Yes, Car Thing has been discontinued. Please visit [LINK] for official device support and refund/credit options for affected hardware owners.

customer_query: @user When is Spotify HiFi / Lossless audio finally coming? We've been waiting for 3 years!
agent_resolution: Hey! We know folks are excited about lossless audio! We don't have a release date to share just yet, but keep an eye on our official newsroom for announcements.

customer_query: @user Why did you remove the lyrics button on the free mobile tier? I can't read lyrics anymore.
agent_resolution: Hi! Lyrics availability varies across tiers, markets, and devices as we continually test and iterate on our features. We appreciate the feedback and will pass it to the product team.

customer_query: @user How do I set Spotify as the default music provider on my Google Nest speaker?
agent_resolution: Hey! Open the Google Home app > Settings > Music, select Spotify, and link your account credentials. You can then say 'Hey Google, play my music'.

customer_query: @user The new UI update is absolutely hideous and unusable. Who designed this mess?? Roll it back!
agent_resolution: Hey there. We're always experimenting with updates to make discovering audio easier, but we understand change takes getting used to. We've logged your feedback for our design team.

customer_query: @user Another price increase? You guys are getting way too greedy. Might switch to Apple Music.
agent_resolution: Hi. To continue investing in and innovating on our product offerings and features, we occasionally update our pricing. We appreciate your loyalty and hope you stay with us.

customer_query: @user Customer support on Twitter takes hours to respond! Terrible customer experience.
agent_resolution: We're so sorry for the delay! We're experiencing higher volume than usual today. How can we help you right now?

customer_query: @user Shuffle algorithm is broken. It plays the same 10 songs out of my 800 song playlist every single day.
agent_resolution: Hey! Try turning off 'Automix' in Playback Settings and clear your app cache. Spotify shuffle uses a complex distribution algorithm, but clearing cache resets the session seed.

customer_query: @user hey what's up
agent_resolution: Hey there! How can we help with your Spotify account today?

customer_query: @user Can you tell Taylor Swift that I love her so much??
agent_resolution: We love Taylor too! We can't pass personal messages, but you can stream all her eras on Spotify!

customer_query: @user ?
agent_resolution: Hey! Did you have a question or need assistance with your music streaming? Let us know!
